results.title: Ananab Ananab
results.overview: When an eleven-year-old boy loses his mum’s attention to her new church (and a charismatic but creepy pastor), he must learn to speak in tongues to get her back.

results.title: Intrusion
results.overview: An arrogant vlogger disturbs what should not be disturbed.

results.title: Ada Kesedihan di Matamu
results.overview: A man sees a woman being threatened and wants to be her hero but he never imagined how completely his life would change because of it.

results.title: The Canvasser
results.overview: A canvasser haunts a performative male who "forgets" to vote.

results.title: A FATHER FIGURE
results.overview: A behind the scenes look at the inspiration behind Jon Bellion’s third studio album ‘FATHER FIGURE’ and the lead up to his live performance at Forest Hills Stadium.

results.title: Dehumanized
results.overview: Evelyn is no stranger to street harassment from vulgar men — she has to bury herself in her phone just to stay sane while walking home. However, as she slowly loses her identity to being the victim of a gore-obsessed stalker, this dependency on distraction leaves her unaware of just how dangerous her situation has gotten.

results.title: Luboš
results.overview: Luboš lives his daily life in fear of dirt. What most people take for granted can be a source of anxiety for him and an obstacle he must constantly overcome. The documentary follows his daily activities, how he copes with his situation, and his journey toward peace of mind.

results.title: Clutch
results.overview: In a futuristic Lagos, Kay, bike mechanic prodigy, yearns to become a street racer like his idol Maze. Desperate to turn his dream into reality, he enters the dangerous Japa Rush. Will he make it to the finish line?

results.title: Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR
results.original_title: Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR
results.overview: In the 1980s, the GDR provided shelter to ten RAF terrorists. The State Security Service (Stasi) furnished these individuals — who had left the group — with new identities, enabling them to lead inconspicuous lives within the GDR. Among them was Silke Maier-Witt, a member of the second generation of the RAF, who had been involved in the kidnapping of Hanns Martin Schleyer. She recounts her experiences during her time in the socialist German state. Filmmaker Claus Räfle reconstructs how the Stasi protected these former terrorists and concealed their identities. Through interviews with Silke Maier-Witt, other contemporary witnesses, and experts — complemented by archival footage and photorealistic, AI-animated scenes (created by Helmut Fischer and Parviz Balucci) that capture the atmosphere of the era — the film unfolds as a historical documentary-thriller.

results.title: Ghost on the Lake
results.overview: The story of a couple who move to a new area and discover their good fortune in having a lake only a short distance away. They go exploring, only to find it abandoned by all its residents except one, and they are wary of her. After hearing claims of a ghost in the area, they decide to investigate. They are shocked and amazed by the events they witness on this quiet little lake.

results.title: The Last resort
results.overview: When a teenager gets dumped by his partner, he hastily spirals into suicidal thoughts.

results.title: Home
results.overview: Ben gets a letter stating that he has been deemed not suitable to raise a child, aka Crewmate. He must give up the child, or he will be at risk of losing his home. Not wanting to be separated from his child, but also not wanting to lose 2 homes in a year, Ben tries to find as many legal loopholes as possible to ensure he can keep both his home and child, but eventually, he'll need to come to a choice.

results.title: Threaded: Adelaide
results.overview: A documentary event exploring the designers, photographers and makers shaping South Australia’s fashion scene.

results.title: TroIA
results.overview: Martin, a graphic designer trapped in front of a blank screen, struggles unsuccessfully to finish a logo. When inspiration fails to come, he turns to TroIA, an artificial intelligence that promises to help him. But as the tool learns from him, Martin begins to wonder how much of what he creates is still truly his.

results.title: passed away
results.overview: new york city seen through motion photography

results.title: Jim
results.overview: A man equally enamoured by the beauty of jazz and his beloved wife, Jim shares his deeply intimate thoughts with us. From New Orleans jazz to the difficulties of grieving someone before they’ve died, Jim is a poetic portrait of a mournful clarinettist.

results.title: Stain
results.overview: Haunted by trauma, a psychologically unstable teenager is compelled to visit his sick grandmother with his half-sister and their friends. Being back in his childhood home, his dark past resurfaces, forcing him to confront whether the true horror lies in the island - the people from his past, or within himself.
